source_description_html:
These Rox Risers feature a 2" center to center rise. They will mount on essentially any machine that has a handlebar that measures 1 1/8" at the bar clamps, has an open mounting area, and has enough cable slack to accommodate the additional rise.

Features:

  • 2" Rise x 1 1/8" Stem Clamp x 1 1/8" Handlebar
  • Can be pivoted to desire fore and aft location for ideal riding position
  • CNC machined from billet 6061 T6 aluminum
  • Made in the USA
